name: Ann Reid
bio: Writer and novelist, Louis Wilkinson's second wife, married after his 1923 divorce from Frances Gregg. They had a daughter, to whom Wilkinson dedicated Seven Friends (1953). She died in 1932.
bio_note: The wedding is undated in everything read; only her 1932 death has a year, sourced on the article to Malcolm Elwin, The Life of Llewelyn Powys (1946), p. 207. The marriage itself is footnoted to Wilkinson's own Seven Friends dedication page and to Friedman (2002), p. 13. Eliot letter of 9 February 1929; Ann Reid to Wilkinson's own Seven Friends (1953) dedication and to Friedman (2002), with her 1932 death to Elwin (1946), p. 207; Diana Bryn to Who Was Who; Joan Lamburn to his Times obituary.
